# Pune Global Group

> Pune Global Group is an industrial packaging manufacturer in Pune, India, producing precision PP trays, boxes, separators, crates and bins for automotive, pharma and electronics, plus converting and trading FBB paper & board grades across 21 Indian states. Est. 1995.

## Key facts
- Type: B2B industrial packaging manufacturer & paper/board trader
- Audience: automotive OEMs, pharma manufacturers, electronics makers, FMCG and packaging buyers across India
- Founded: 1995, Pune, Maharashtra
- Facilities: Sanaswadi MIDC plant + Gulmohar Centre Point office, Pune
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, FSC, BRC
- Product categories: PP corrugated packaging and Paper & Board
- Serves: 21 states, 50+ active clients, 1M+ ton material supplied
- Status: Live production facility, export-ready

## Products — PP Corrugated Packaging

### PP Boxes (manufactured, returnable)
Six closure systems: riveted, ultrasonic weld, interlock, detachable lid, velcro and collapsible. Custom dimensions for automotive and pharma.

- PP Box — Open Top Riveted: heavy-duty open-top PP corrugated box with riveted vertical seams for bulk industrial handling.
- PP Box — Ultrasonic Weld: seamless ultrasonic-welded PP corrugated box for pharma and cleanroom applications.
- PP Box — Top Flap Interlock: self-locking top-flap box for rapid open/close in assembly line environments.
- PP Box — Detachable Lid: riveted box with removable lid, stackable, kitting-ready, export-grade.
- PP Box — Velcro Closure: repeat-access box for precision components and CNC parts.
- PP Box — Collapsible: fold-flat returnable box, saves 70% return freight volume.

### Separators & Inserts (manufactured, precision die-cut)
Cross-partition grids and contour die-cut inserts engineered to ±1 mm for glass, automotive and pharma component separation.

- PP Cross Partition Grid: interlocking slot-lock corrugated grid divider for glass, bottles and small parts.
- PP Custom Die-Cut Insert: precision die-cut corrugated contour insert for component-specific protection.

### Layer Pads
- PP Heavy Duty Layer Pad: 4 mm corrugated layer pad for glass, automotive and high-load pallet stacking. 200–500 trip reuse cycle.

### Trays (manufactured)
- PP Folded Corner Tray: no-tooling-cost fold-and-cut tray for assembly staging and WIP transfer.
- PP Stackable Interlock Tray: interlocking rib tray engineered for 8-high pallet stacking and 20 kg dynamic loads.
- PP Fixed Divider Tray: colour-coded kitting tray with rivet-and-slot fixed grid dividers.
- PP Foam Laminated Tray: EVA foam-laminated tray for vibration-sensitive optical and precision components.
- PP ESD Anti-Static Tray: conductive corrugated tray with 10^4–10^6 Ω/sq surface resistivity for PCB and electronics handling. ANSI/ESD S20.20 compatible.

### Bins (industrial, factory floor)
Colour-coded, forklift-rated, kanban-compatible.

- PP Open Top Scrap Bin: 900 mm tall riveted scrap bin for forklift environments and dry waste segregation.
- PP Hopper Front Bin: kanban-compatible hopper bin for assembly line small-part picking and shelving.
- PP Nesting Tapered Bin: 30% space-saving tapered bin, 10 units nest in 3 single-bin heights for reverse logistics.
- PP Stackable Open Front Picking Bin: shelving-rail compatible open-front bin for warehouse inventory picking.

### Protection
- PP Temporary Floor Protection Sheet: 2.4 m × 1.2 m forklift-rated floor protection for construction, fit-out and warehouse paths.

## Products — Paper & Board (converted + traded)

- Cyber XLPac GC1: India's first FBB — the industry standard for high-quality folding carton packaging.
- Cyber XLPac GC2: higher bulk, uncoated manila back — better yield and slip resistance on filling lines.
- Cyber Premium: high-bulk FBB engineered for glass bottles and heavy-content cartons.
- PearlXL Packaging: value-packed FBB, cost-effective upgrade from recycled boards for everyday packaging.
- Carte Lumina: avant-garde luxury virgin board for cosmetics, perfumes and premium brand packaging.
- Safire Graphik: India's first SBS board — brilliant white, silky texture for cards, cartons and personal care.
- Cyber Oak: brownback FBB from virgin fibres, natural organic aesthetic with premium print topside.
- Eco Natura: best-in-class recycled greyback board, consistent caliper, smooth filling line performance.
- Eco Blanca: recycled whiteback board, C2S coated, low dirt count, excellent two-side print reproduction.
- NeoWhite Bliss: high-performance recovered fibre board engineered for blister card packaging.

## Infrastructure & Capabilities

In-house converting machinery: Flat Bed Punch Press, Plastic Ultrasonic Welder, Screen Printing Unit, Guillotine Sheeter, Synchro Sheeter, Stretch Wrap & Forklift Despatch.

- Flat Bed Punch Press: precision flatbed die-cutting for PP corrugated sheet — cuts boxes, trays and separators to exact finished dimensions.
- Plastic Ultrasonic Welder: ultrasonic welding for seamless PP corrugated box fabrication — pharma-grade clean joins with no adhesive.
- Screen Printing Unit: flat-bed screen printing on PP corrugated panels — part numbers, barcodes, colour coding and logos.
- Guillotine Sheeter: precision guillotine cutting of ITC FBB, duplex and kraft board to exact converter dimensions.
- Synchro Sheeter: high-speed sheeting with synchronised register for print-grade ITC FBB sheets.
- Stretch Wrap & Forklift Despatch: automated pallet stretch wrapping and forklift-assisted loading for transit-ready pallet despatch.
